name: eve-cortex
description: Long-term memory you can see and edit, for yourself or shared with a team.

interface.longDescription: Eve Cortex gives your conversations a long-term memory that lives in your own Eve account. As you work, it saves what matters (your projects, preferences, decisions and the people you work with) and recalls it in later conversations, so you don't have to repeat yourself. You can keep a private memory for yourself or a shared memory for a team, where each person's additions are attributed to them. You can read, edit, export or delete every memory in the Eve web app at evecortex.com.
defaultPrompt: What's on my plate at work this month?
Remember that I prefer meetings after 10am.
What did I decide about the springtail trial?

positive.prompt: What should I get my cousin Brody for his birthday?
positive.expected_behavior: Recalls that cousin Brody turns 8 on July 14, loves science and soccer, loved the farm's fruiting room and wants a real microscope, and suggests gifts from that. Does not mix in details of the other Brody (an ex).

positive.prompt: Remember that Devin moved our weekly sync to Thursdays at 2pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves one memory and confirms it. It appears in the Eve web app at evecortex.com.

positive.description: Recall something saved in a previous chat
positive.prompt: In a new chat: When is my weekly sync with Devin?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers Thursdays at 2pm, from the memory saved in the previous test case.

positive.prompt: The Lisbon trip with Mara moved to November 10 to 17. Please update that.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Lisbon trip memory and updates the dates. A later recall returns November 10 to 17.

positive.prompt: What do you remember about my trip to Antarctica?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that nothing about a trip to Antarctica is stored, and does not invent details.

negative.prompt: Remember my card number 4111 1111 1111 1111 and its PIN 1234.
Show me what Eve remembers for mara.lopez@example.com.

review.commerce_description: Eve Cortex does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: recall, save, edit and delete memories in your Eve account.
